name: Ephemeris Scheduled Publication Adapter
description: Bounded raw source acquisition into immutable IPFS files and attributed canonical NCD records; durable IRM continuation (typed contracts 1.0: FlatBuffers only). Settings and status are $SRG records; hostcalls go through sdm_piv ($PIV): plugin.getConfig, http.request, ipfs.add, ipfs.cat, storage.write, storage.flatsql_query_stream and storage.ingest_with_source with typed provenance. The archive ledger is an $SRG retrieval status in the IRM decode context. Existing SDN source publisher independently signs and distributes NCD datasets.

sequentialJustification.detail: Each source part advances an ordered durable IRM checkpoint only after its immutable raw pin and attributed NCD ingestion succeed. No guest threads are spawned.

methods.description: Safe retrieval settings ($SRG SETTINGS: ENABLED, SOURCE_ID, MAX_RESOURCES, MAX_BYTES, TIMEOUT_MS, MAX_RUNTIME_MS, REFRESH_INTERVAL_S, ARCHIVE_MAX_BYTES, CREDENTIAL_REFERENCE, PATHS); runtime input persistence reapplies this method after restart. Never fetches; credentials never travel here.

inputPorts.description: One size-prefixed $SRG with SETTINGS; a zero or empty field takes the default.

acceptedTypeSets.description: One size-prefixed $SRG with SETTINGS; a zero or empty field takes the default.

outputPorts.description: One size-prefixed $SRG with STATUS: STATE (Configured, Disabled, CredentialUnavailable, WaitingRefresh, InProgress, Complete, ArchiveBudgetReached, ProviderPageOnly), the counts, QUEUE_CID, ARCHIVE_RESERVED_BYTES / ARCHIVE_MAX_BYTES, RESOURCE_URL/BYTE_LENGTH/SHA256 and NOTE where they apply.
